subject.title: fix(agents): refresh completed subagents in Control UI [AI-assisted]

question: After the branch is refreshed onto current main, should the agents-area owner accept this narrow interrupted-recovery-only terminal event publication rule as the canonical recovery behavior?
rationale: The patch is targeted and proof-backed, but it changes the terminal session-event contract that reconciles persisted subagent state with connected Control UI clients; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision rather than automated closure or merge.

options.title: Accept the narrow recovery rule
options.body: Merge after rebase and required checks if the owner agrees that a recovered terminal generation must publish one initial status event without changing ordinary suppression behavior.

options.title: Request a broader event-invariant design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want terminal session notifications to be decoupled from all completion-side-effect suppression paths rather than fixing only interrupted recovery.
